content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for KV Thane Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: No Pay during Summer Vacation/Autumn Break/Winter Break If remains absent on working day, payment will be calculated on pro-rata basis Working hours shall be same as regular teachers Desirable: Qualified in CTET Paper II (for TGT) Experience of working in a school (for TGT) Knowledge of Computer applications Working knowledge of computer / different portals in Hindi & English (for Vocational Lab Instructor)

rows.qualification: Four years integrated degree course with at least 50% marks in concerned subject and aggregate including B.Ed component OR Bachelors/Honours Degree with at least 50% marks and B.Ed Degree with at least 50% marks OR Three years integrated B.Ed-M.Ed with at least 50% marks OR One year B.Ed (Special Education) with at least 50% marks; Studied Biology/Life Science/Botany/Zoology as Hons/Main Subject in at least 03 years/06 semester with required combination of subjects

Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education OR 4-years Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed) OR 2-years Diploma in Education (Special Education); Proficiency to teach through Hindi & English medium
B.E. or B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering with minimum one year experience

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Four years integrated degree course with at least 50% marks in concerned subject and aggregate including B.Ed component OR Bachelors/Honours Degree with at least 50% marks and B.Ed Degree with at least 50% marks OR Three years integrated B.Ed-M.Ed with at least 50% marks OR One year B.Ed (Special Education) with at least 50% marks; Studied Biology/Life Science/Botany/Zoology as Hons/Main Subject in at least 03 years/06 semester with required combination of subjects. Pay: Rs.26250 per month. Qualification required: Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education OR 4-years Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed) OR 2-years Diploma in Education (Special Education); Proficiency to teach through Hindi & English medium. Pay: Rs.21250 per month. Qualification required: B.E. or B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering with minimum one year experience. Pay: Rs.25000 per month.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for KV Thane Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for KV Thane Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 29 October 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for KV Thane Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.26250 per month for TGT (Science), Rs.21250 per month for Primary Teacher, Rs.25000 per month for Vocational Instructor.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Ed, 12th, Diploma, B.Tech/B.E., depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No Pay during Summer Vacation/Autumn Break/Winter Break. If remains absent on working day, payment will be calculated on pro-rata basis. Working hours shall be same as regular teachers.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Registration on the day of Walk-in-Interview. Interview. Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q7. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on temporary contractual basis for academic year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Thane.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Xerox copies of testimonials; Original testimonials.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number of this recruitment?
faq.answer: It is Advt No. Ref.F.27049/Cont.Tr.Appt./2026-27/KVTHN.
